description.value:
Hashirama's signature Wood Release. From the earth, walls, or even thin air around a point you choose within 60 feet, thick wooden branches grow in a 10-foot burst and converge on every creature in the area.

Creatures in the area attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, they become grabbed by the wood (Escape DC = your spell DC) and the wood-mass becomes difficult terrain. On a critical failure, they are also restrained.

The wood structure has Hardness 10, HP 40 per 5-foot segment, and BT 20. It lasts for 1 minute or until destroyed.

Heightened (+1) Damage to anyone breaking free increases by 1d6 splinter damage; structure HP increases by 10 per segment.

system.requirements: you have the Mokuton kekkei genkai
